title: VDBE label resolution, progress checks, and reusable-program marker

scope.rationale: These active source functions and state fields form the dependency-closed label state machine used by the VDBE builder: negative label issuance, geometric label-array growth, resolve-to-next-op, hundred-label progress checks, interrupt/callback propagation, and Expire/Noop reusable marking. They extend the admitted fixed-operand append core and share its connection allocation/OOM closure.
excluded_responsibilities: Final resolveP2Values label fixup over completed operation arrays
General progress checks outside label growth
Debug-only add-op tracing and inactive progress-callback omission profile

external_source_responsibilities: Connection progress-handler configuration and caller-held mutex
Final operation-array P2 fixup during readiness
dependencies.caller_closure: All direct state and helpers used by label issuance/resolution, hundred-boundary progress checks, and reusable marking are assigned. Compiler callers and final fixup/readiness remain follow-on atomic units.

inputs: INIT-state Vdbe/Parse/connection, issued negative label, current operation count, progress callback configuration, interrupt flag
outputs: Negative label ID, resolved operation address in Parse.aLabel, sticky OOM/interrupt Parse state, and Expire-to-Noop reusable marker
contracts.ownership: Parse owns the connection-allocated aLabel array. ReallocOrFree destroys the prior array on growth failure exactly as source; successful growth updates allocation slots and target.
contracts.state_and_results: nLabel is the negative issued count. nLabelAlloc grows to 10-nLabel. Resolution binds once to Vdbe.nOp. Every crossed hundred invokes progress checking after allocation and before publication. Interrupt and callback results update nErr/rc/nProgressSteps in source order.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex. Progress callback may run at hundred-label boundaries and is invoked after checking the atomic interrupt. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Label growth OOM clears aLabel/nLabelAlloc, preserves sticky connection/Parse OOM, and permits reallocation after explicit OOM/fault clear. Interrupt does not prevent publishing the resolved target.

representation_differences: C ADDR macro is the typed labelAddress complement helper.
C relaxed AtomicLoad is Zig monotonic @atomicLoad.
The active non-debug profile does not initialize unused label slots to -1; native likewise publishes only the resolved slot.
Canonical opcode enum values represent OP_Expire and OP_Noop without changing u8 storage.

oracle.protocol: The shared symbolic VDBE-builder program now drives label issuance, initial and hundred-boundary growth, resolution targets, progress callback configuration, atomic interrupt propagation, reusable marking, reached realloc OOM, realloc-or-free ownership loss, explicit clear, and continuation through pinned C and Zig workers.
oracle.normalization: Label values, capacities, targets, result states and opcodes are exact. Pointer values are reduced only to null/non-null ownership.

assurance.oom: The 366-observation builder trace reaches label realloc failure, verifies realloc-or-free ownership loss and sticky OOM, then resumes after clear.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Atomic interrupt ordering and callback invocation are traced; caller mutex ownership remains an integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Internal labels are generated by makeLabel; source assertions constrain range and one-time resolution.
assurance.continuation: Post-OOM label reallocation and post-interrupt target publication match source.
assurance.performance: Negative counts, 10-slot slack growth, hundred-boundary progress checks, and read/write order follow source.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic native builder worker reaches exact Vdbe/Parse/Sqlite3 owners; production SQL still uses handwritten Program construction.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Compiler ownership switch waits for complete builder labels/fixups/P4/lifecycle closure.

independent_review.notes: Requires final fixup/compiler integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Final P2 fixup is now trace-equivalent; integrate it through MakeReady and the production compiler owner.
Integrate source builder into compiler ownership and retire handwritten Program construction.
Complete callback reentrancy/concurrency assurance and independent fidelity review.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:575-677 was reviewed completely for negative-label issuance, realloc-or-free growth, hundred-boundary progress checks, resolution, and Expire/Noop marking
upstream/sqlite/src/util.c:185-236 was reviewed completely for atomic interrupt and progress callback ordering/state
upstream/sqlite/src/vdbe.h:170-182 and sqliteInt.h connection/Parse neighborhoods were reviewed for ADDR, label storage, progress state, and callback transport
src/core/internal/vdbe_aux.zig label/progress/reuse functions and exact parse/vdbe_types fields are canonical AST-hashed targets
callers: Expression, SELECT, WHERE, mutation, foreign-key, trigger, pragma, analyze, and window code issue and resolve labels
WHERE and SELECT additionally call sqlite3ProgressCheck during expensive compile loops; this unit owns the same helper behavior reached by label growth
Pragma uses RunOnlyOnce/Reusable to retain or rewrite the mandatory OP_Expire marker; final negative-P2 sweep belongs to readiness/fixup
callees: MakeLabel pre-decrements negative nLabel; ADDR bit-complements a label into its aLabel index
resizeResolveLabel grows to 10-nLabel with sqlite3DbReallocOrFree, clears allocation count on failure, checks progress on crossed hundreds, then publishes capacity and current nOp target
ProgressCheck atomically reads interrupt first, then increments callback steps or invokes xProgress and normalizes steps to zero on interrupt/callback threshold
RunOnlyOnce appends Expire(1,1); Reusable finds the invariant Expire marker and rewrites operation one to Noop
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 16 behavior IDs cover interrupt/callback paths, label growth/failure/publication, resolution range/once assertions, and reusable scan
Realloc-or-free consumes old aLabel on failure and sets pointer/count null/zero while sticky OOM remains in connection/Parse state
Resolution still publishes the target after a progress callback reports interrupt; no I/O occurs and callback reentrancy remains an assurance obligation
Debug unresolved-slot initialization and add-op tracing are inactive in the pinned profile
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/progress.test exercises callback thresholds, interruption, errors, and continuation; interrupt.test exercises interrupt state across statements
Broad expression/planner/mutation suites exercise forward labels and final fixup; pragma tests exercise reusable statement behavior
